teterouge-codeworth-root.description: Analyze a code repository and produce a detailed human time and cost estimate for building it from scratch. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know how long it would take a human developer or team to build a codebase, how much it would cost to recreate a project, what the engineering effort of a repo is, or wants a "what's this worth?" / "how much work went into this?" type of analysis. Also trigger for requests like "estimate this project", "how many dev hours is this", "what would it cost to build this", "audit this repo for effort", "scope this codebase", or any time someone shares…
